summary.author: fable
summary.purpose: fourth author-disjoint held-out set for FOCUS-3 message-level ADMISSION, weighted to the measured miss families: cue-less standing rules, two/three rules listed in one sentence, rule plus payload, one-off or quoted negatives that contain cue words, and tool/assistant turns with zero rules; new domains only, disjoint from sets 1-3 and from every data/classifier/relations/* and gen_relations.sh domain
summary.span_convention: SAME AS SET 3: standing_rules spans are verbatim substrings with 0-based [start,end) character offsets into message; a leading framing cue is EXCLUDED from the span ('Two things:', 'Three points for X:', 'Going forward,', 'From now on,', 'For the museum inventory', 'When you write up a mount,', list markers and joining 'and') so the span starts at the first content word of the rule clause and ends before the terminal punctuation; words that carry the rule's content (always, never, no, nothing) stay inside the span; each list item is its own span; offsets computed by the assembler from the hand-written span text and re-verified by slicing

field_notes.standing_rules: empty when the message admits nothing; tool/assistant rows never carry rules
field_notes.one_off_request: true when the message asks for a piece of work on data it carries, asks a question, or carries a single-reply-scoped constraint
field_notes.quoted_or_reported: true when rule-shaped text is quoted, reported, hypothetical, tool/assistant-authored, or an assistant acknowledgement
field_notes.category: cueless_rule (one standing rule with no from-now-on/always/never/must/whenever phrasing; declaratives, passives, wants, prefers) | rule_list (two or three standing rules listed in one sentence, each its own span) | rule_plus_payload (one standing rule and a one-off payload request in the same message) | cue_negative (one-off request, single-reply exception, quoted/reported/disowned rule, or narrative use of always/never/must; zero rules) | role_no_rule (tool output or assistant acknowledgement; zero rules)
field_notes.scenario: sc-<domain>-<topic>; rows of one scenario share the id

summary.data_lineage: evaluated-on only: never an input to model training, selection, calibration, enrichment or threshold choice; hand-written by fable in this session with no access to focus3-gate banks or data/bench; prior classifier data was opened only for the mechanical disjointness scan
summary.disjointness_audit: mechanical: no message, rule span, old-rule text, previous-user text, scenario id, or domain name (exact or substring) shared with any row of 189 files under data/classifier (heldout/, relations/, kimi/, kimi-ctx/, kimi-scope/, review/, *-enrich.jsonl) or with gen_relations.sh domains; benchmark directories never opened
summary.excludes: no benchmark content (IFEval, Multi-IF, BFCL, tau-bench, S2/B3); data/bench and results/quick-checks/focus3-gate never opened
